chars.AMINE: AMINE: a slim young man wearing a burgundy velvet blazer over a black t-shirt, black slim trousers and white sneakers.
chars.SALMA: SALMA: an elegant woman (bald white head like everyone, with big gold hoop earrings) wearing a long black satin evening dress with thin straps and a thick gold necklace.
chars.GROOM: GROOM: a man wearing a white Moroccan jabador with gold embroidery and a red fez (tarbouche).
chars.BRIDE: BRIDE: a woman wearing a green and gold Moroccan takchita with a gold crown.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Inside a parked luxury white car at night in Casablanca, SALMA in the back seat leans forward and grabs AMINE's arm, pleading intensely; AMINE in the driver seat turns back, shocked and hesitant. Tension between them. City lights outside the windows.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: In a luxury jewelry shop in Casablanca, SALMA slides a thick men's gold ring onto AMINE's finger while he stares at it nervously; glass display cases behind them.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: On the street outside a jewelry shop, SALMA hands AMINE a big expensive black gift box with a gold ribbon; AMINE holds it surprised, his mouth open.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: SALMA and AMINE walk arm in arm into a huge lavish Moroccan wedding hall with chandeliers, zellige walls, round tables and guests; SALMA smiles proudly, AMINE looks nervous.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In a lavish Moroccan wedding hall, in the foreground SALMA and AMINE sit close together acting like a loving couple, SALMA leaning on AMINE's shoulder; in the background the GROOM and BRIDE sit on a decorated golden wedding throne, and the GROOM stares at them.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Close view of the GROOM on the golden wedding throne glaring angrily across the hall with a jealous furious expression, clenching his fist, while the BRIDE next to him looks at him confused.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: At a wedding table AMINE gently kisses SALMA's hand like a gentleman while she smiles; in the background the GROOM in his wedding outfit watches them, furious, arms crossed.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: At a wedding table under a chandelier, AMINE leans in and whispers into SALMA's ear with a cheeky smile; SALMA laughs with her hand on her mouth.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: In the middle of the lavish Moroccan wedding hall dance floor, AMINE goes down on one knee in front of SALMA, who covers her mouth in shock; guests around them freeze and stare; in the background the GROOM stands up from his throne, shocked.
